**Subject: Grant Application for Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC) - Everytown Safety Fund**

Glocks and Fried Chicken (GAFC) seeks Everytown Safety Fund support for vital gun safety education in Sacramento's communities of color. These communities face disproportionately high rates of gun-related injuries and deaths, often lacking culturally relevant safety resources and education. Our mission addresses this critical need directly.

GAFC, a minority-owned social enterprise, delivers innovative, community-led programs. Our "Gloxsie 21" cartoon IP provides engaging gun safety lessons for youth, while our AI education component equips families with digital literacy to identify misinformation and understand firearm technology responsibly. We host regular, accessible community workshops in partnership with the trusted Church of Legacy, fostering open dialogue and practical safety skills like safe storage and de-escalation.

With your support, GAFC will significantly reduce accidental shootings and gun violence in Sacramento by empowering residents with critical knowledge and resources. We anticipate measurable increases in safe gun storage practices, enhanced awareness of gun safety laws, and improved conflict resolution skills, particularly among youth. Our culturally resonant approach builds trust and ensures lasting impact.

GAFC is uniquely qualified due to its deep community roots, led by individuals understanding racialized gun violence. Our innovative media and AI use, combined with the Church of Legacy’s trusted partnership, effectively reaches and educates vulnerable populations. We are committed to a safer Sacramento and seek support within the $50,000-$200,000 range to scale our vital programs.
